articles.title: Zi'Ghi Boneeater
articles.intro: A Paladin Quadav notorious monster in Palborough Mines, around level 15–16.
articles.body_html:
Find and defeat

  1. Reach the third floor of Palborough Mines and the east side of the H-shaped room around H-7/H-8.
  2. Defeat the Veteran Quadav in the Onyx/Veteran/Greater Quadav group. This is a lottery spawn; killing the placeholder does not guarantee the NM. The traditional minimum window is one hour after the previous defeat.
  3. Expect Banish and Invincible. Save physical weapon skills until Invincible ends; isolate it from nearby Quadav.

Notable loot

Braveheart and Coarse Gauntlets.

articles.title: Zhuu Buxu the Silent
articles.intro: Two era versions share this Ninja Yagudo name: a low-level mission target in Giddeus and a stronger NM in Castle Oztroja (S).
articles.body_html:
Giddeus: Parana Shield

  1. In Giddeus, drop to the lower map through the hole near G-8, then head north toward G/H-7 on map 2.
  2. Defeat the level-16 NM and collect Parana Shield. The shield is used in Journey Abroad when Windurst is the first foreign nation visited.
  3. Keep HP topped up for Mijin Gakure. If absent, wait for its timed respawn; classic guides list ten minutes, while later retail reduced this to five.

Castle Oztroja (S)

The level-80–84 version is a lottery from Yagudo Sentinels near H-10 on the first map. Possible rewards are Sangoma Lappa and Yagudo Kote. Pull it clear of the hallway to avoid additional Yagudo; prepare for Mijin Gakure.

articles.title: Zo'Khu Blackcloud
articles.intro: A Black Mage Quadav NM, level 36–38, in Beadeaux.
articles.body_html:
Find and defeat

  1. Go to the upper level of Beadeaux around E-11/F-11.
  2. Kill the Zircon Quadav placeholder and watch subsequent respawns. The classic lottery window opens after about one hour; later retail shortened this, so do not apply the retail timer to an era server without checking.
  3. The NM uses Manafont. Interrupt dangerous spells and keep nearby Quadav out of the fight.

Notable loot

Marine Hat and Faerie Shield.

articles.title: Ziphius
articles.intro: A forced-spawn Pugil NM in Misareaux Coast that can drop Hospitaler Earring.
articles.body_html:
Spawn steps

  1. Bring six Slice of Carp to the Rafelous River in Misareaux Coast. Five ??? points are near H-5; the sixth is farther away near I-6.
  2. Bait the points at night. They appear from 22:00; trading before midnight is a safe common window across the source descriptions.
  3. Between 04:00 and 07:00, examine the baited points. Each check has a chance to produce Ziphius; the bait does not guarantee a spawn.
  4. Defeat it for a chance at Hospitaler Earring. Its hits have additional water damage.

The ??? disappear at 07:00. If the traps fail, bring fresh bait for another night.

articles.title: Zuug the Shoreleaper
articles.intro: A level-70 Dragoon Sahagin NM in Sea Serpent Grotto, hunted for Narval.
articles.body_html:
Where and how

  1. Enter Sea Serpent Grotto and pass the door opened with a Gold Beastcoin.
  2. Search the area around F-10. The Sahagin reference lists a timed spawn after at least two hours.
  3. Prepare for its accompanying Sahagin's Wyvern and nearby Sahagin links.

Notable loot

Narval.

articles.title: Zipacna
articles.intro: A roaming level-83–85 Golem NM in Sky, and a source of Gem of the North.
articles.body_html:
Find and defeat

  1. Complete The Hall of the Gods access requirements for Sky, then enter Ve'Lugannon Palace through the northern entrances from Ru'Aun Gardens.
  2. Search the northern route between E-3 and K-3, including the attached lower loops. Open and closed doors affect the patrol route.
  3. Zipacna is a timed spawn; classic references give a multi-hour window. It moves quickly and can use a TP attack immediately on being pulled.
  4. Keep support away from Crystal Rain and prepare for repeated Crystal Weapon attacks.

Notable loot

Gem of the North for Genbu, Oblation Abjuration, and Ushikirimaru.

articles.title: Zoraal Ja's Pkuucha
articles.intro: A level-75 Colibri NM in Wajaom Woodlands with an additional Beastmaster opponent during the fight.
articles.body_html:
Spawn and battle

  1. Defeat Lesser Colibri near I-9 in Wajaom Woodlands to seek its lottery spawn.
  2. Damage Pkuucha until Percipient Zoraal Ja appears. The bird recovers its HP when its master arrives.
  3. Defeat Percipient Zoraal Ja first: he heals the bird, and the bird cannot be finished while he remains alive.
  4. Resume attacking the bird. Paralyze, Slow and Bind are useful; do not depend on Sleep, Silence or Gravity.

Notable loot

Zoraal Ja's Axe and Fowling Earring.

articles.title: Zizzy Zillah
articles.intro: A hard-hitting Cockatrice NM in Mamook, around level 79.
articles.body_html:
Find and defeat

  1. Hunt Ziz around I-9 in Mamook for a chance at this lottery NM.
  2. Expect frequent Cockatrice TP moves and heavy physical damage. Bring a way to remove petrification.
  3. Do not depend on Sleep; Bind and Gravity can work for controlling its movement.

Notable loot

Fencing Bracers, Namikirimaru, and Ziz Meat.

A separate Nyzul Isle version can appear on floors 21–39. Its appraisal crate can contain a ??? Sword; see Nyzul Isle for that reward system.

articles.title: Zu
articles.intro: Ordinary level-20–23 Birds in Buburimu Peninsula.
articles.body_html:
Where and drops

Find them outdoors in Buburimu Peninsula. They are regular spawns, with no trigger item or quest required. They can link with nearby Zu, so pull one away from the group.

  • Drops: Bird Egg and Bird Feather.
  • Steal: Bird Feather.
  • Crystal: Fire; elemental weakness: Ice.

articles.title: Zircon Quadav
articles.intro: Black Mage Quadav found in present-day and past areas.
articles.body_html:
Locations and useful drops

AreaLevelUseful information
Rolanberry Fields30–36Gil; Silver Beastcoin can be stolen.
Beadeaux34–38Silver Engraving, Wool Hat and Wool Cuffs are listed drops.
Pashhow Marshlands (S)71–74Higher-level past-area version.

These are normal spawns that detect sound and link. Interrupt or silence their spells when possible. One upper-floor Beadeaux spawn is the placeholder for Zo'Khu Blackcloud.

articles.title: Ziz
articles.intro: Cockatrices found in Mamook, Nyzul Isle and the original Zhayolm Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Locations and rewards

  • Mamook: level 76–78 regular monsters. Drops include Giant Bird Feather and Ziz Meat. The group near I-9 can produce Zizzy Zillah.
  • Nyzul Isle: appear as normal floor enemies; Giant Bird Feather and Ziz Meat are listed.
  • Zhayolm Remnants: the original Salvage version can drop Praecipitatio Cell. Follow the floor route for cell distribution.

They detect by sight. Bring petrification removal for Cockatrice attacks and pull clear of nearby monsters.

articles.title: Zephyr
articles.intro: A level-72 throwing ammunition item associated with Sky battles.
articles.body_html:
Obtain and use

  1. Defeat Byakko in Ru'Aun Gardens to obtain Zephyr.
  2. Equip it in the ammo slot. It has DMG 250 and Delay 276.
  3. Its special Sky use is a successful ranged hit against Seiryu to remove his additional elemental damage effect. It is consumed when thrown.

articles.title: Zhayolm Apkallu
articles.intro: Level-70–74 Apkallu on Zazalda Island in Mount Zhayolm.
articles.body_html:
Where and rewards

Look around the L-6 area of Mount Zhayolm. Normal drops include Apkallu Egg and Apkallu Feather.

Battle notes

  • Repeated kills raise shared Apkallu hostility in the zone. Their resistance, aggression and tendency to link can increase.
  • Turn your character away when Yawn or Frigid Shuffle begins to avoid the gaze effect.
  • At low HP they may run toward another Apkallu. Bind or Gravity can prevent a chase and extra links.
  • Blue Mages can use Apkallu for Yawn learning; see the spell page for learning requirements.

articles.title: Zombie
articles.intro: Night-spawning Skeletons, using Warrior or Black Mage behavior depending on the area.
articles.body_html:
Where to find

AreaLevel

Pashhow Marshlands16–26
Meriphataud Mountains16–26

Pashhow Marshlands (S)67–69

They appear between 20:00 and 04:00 Vana’diel time. No spawn item is required.

Drops and fighting

Bone Chip is both a drop and a steal item. Zombies detect sound and low HP. Avoid approaching while injured; deal with the Black Mage version’s spells and use Fire or Light damage when suitable.

articles.title: Ziryu
articles.intro: Worm adds summoned during the Ouryu battlefield encounters.
articles.body_html:
Encounter

Four Ziryu accompany Ouryu in Ouryu Cometh. They can also appear when Ouryu is summoned during The Wyrmking Descends. These are battlefield adds, rather than a normal Riverne camp.

Handle the adds

They cast dangerous earth magic, including Stonega III and Quake. Assign control or interruption while the main group handles Ouryu. Beastmasters can Charm them.

Listed drops

Worm Mulch; the Riverne A01 listing also includes Lugworm Sand. Follow the main battlefield page for entry items and victory rewards.

articles.title: Zlatorog
articles.intro: The Ram boss on floor 2 of the original NW Apollyon Limbus route.
articles.body_html:
Access

Reach Sea, obtain Cosmo-Cleanse and a Red Card, then enter NW Apollyon from the Dem-side Al’Taieu entrance. Advance to floor 2.

Battle and rewards

Zlatorog repeatedly uses Mighty Strikes. Prepare defensive abilities and keep the healer ready; clear or avoid the nearby Mountain Buffalo. Ancient Beastcoin is a listed drop. Follow the NW Apollyon route for floor chests and the final Magenta Chip reward.

articles.title: Zuu Xowu the Darksmoke
articles.intro: The Black Mage Yagudo in the level-60 Divine Punishers BCNM.
articles.body_html:
How to encounter

Enter Divine Punishers at Balga's Dais with a Moon Orb. The original encounter allows six players and lasts 30 minutes.

Battle and rewards

Zuu Xowu can use Manafont once. Control the other Yagudo and interrupt dangerous magic as your party’s strategy allows. Rewards belong to the battlefield’s Armoury Crate; use the Divine Punishers loot table. This page covers the original BCNM, not the later high-tier Divine Punishers II.

articles.title: Zeni
articles.intro: The currency used to buy Zeni Notorious Monster trigger items from Sanraku.
articles.body_html:
Earn Zeni: short steps

  1. Speak to Ryo and Sanraku in Aht Urhgan Whitegate at E-8. Ask Ryo which fauna Sanraku currently wants photographed.
  2. Visit Zandjarl at F-7 inside The Colosseum. Exchange Imperial currency for Jettons and buy a Soultrapper plus Blank Soul Plate ammunition.
  3. Equip the camera and blank plates. Approach a suitable living monster and use the Soultrapper from your item menu. A successful picture produces a Soul Plate.
  4. Take pictures close to the monster, from the front, with its HP low when safe. Preferred fauna and better pictures increase the reward.
  5. Trade the completed plates to Sanraku. The classic limit is ten plates per Vana’diel day.
  6. Spend the balance on a trigger, then follow Zeni Notorious Monsters for the tier route.

Exact Zeni yields and prices depend on server settings. This guide uses the era photography method; it does not assume later Rhapsodies bonuses.

articles.title: Zeni Notorious Monsters
articles.intro: A tiered endgame system: earn Zeni, buy a trigger, defeat the NM and exchange its trophy to unlock the next tier.
articles.body_html:
Progression steps

  1. Collect Zeni and speak to Sanraku in Aht Urhgan Whitegate E-8. Select the unique-fauna purchase menu.
  2. Buy a Tier I trigger and trade it to that NM’s ???. The trigger is consumed.
  3. Take the trophy back to Sanraku for a colored seal. Spend that seal plus Zeni on a Tier II trigger; repeat to reach Tier III.
  4. For Tier IV, collect all three different Tier III seals on the chosen path. Buying the higher trigger consumes the required seals.
  5. Tier IV trophies lead to the final Pandemonium Warden path; some are also required for Mythic Weapons.

Tier III targets needed for each Tier IV boss

Achamoth, Khromasoul Bhurborlor, NosferatuSarameya

Tier IV island access

Ask Ryo about islets, then buy the appropriate salt key item from Sanraku. Each participant needs their own salt; the classic price is 500 Zeni. Gather everyone on the island before spawning the boss.
